summary: Iteration 96 — Two-price model (B2B + dealerRetailPrice) end-to-end verification. Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases PASS + 7/7 regression test_dealer_overrides_upsert.py PASS = 17/17. All key invariants verified: (1) GET /api/dealer/sauna/prices returns basePrice=dealerRetailPrice(20000), b2bPrice=override(15000), baseRetailWm=original WM brutto for the seeded model, and costPrice is recursively stripped from the whole response. (2) PUT /api/dealer/sauna/overrides changes only dealerRetailPrice and preserves admin-set B2B price; symmetric: PUT /api/admin/dealers/{id}/overrides changes only B2B price and preserves dealer-set retail. (3) POST .../overrides/bulk-markup with percent=20, base=b2b, scope=models correctly produces retail=18000 for B2B=15000 and ONLY touches model rows (variants/options scope-correctly skipped). (4) POST /api/dealer/sauna/orders auto-computes manufacturerTotal=15000 (= B2B sum), preserves order.total=20000 (dealer retail). (5) PUT /api/dealer/sauna/orders/{id} recomputes manufacturerTotal. (6) POST /api/dealer/sauna/orders/{id}/confirm preserves manufacturerTotal (=15000) and total (=20000). (7) POST /api/admin/dealer-orders/recompute-manufacturer-totals backfills (updated>=1). (8) POST /api/sauna/orders/recompute-margins succeeds (uses manufacturerTotal as brutto baseline for dealer orders per source review of routes/sauna_orders.py:_recompute_one L418-432). Frontend: dealer login → 'Mój cennik' tab fully verified — header 'Moje ceny detaliczne', summary cards (1/82 pozycji z marżą, średnia marża 33.3%), 82 retail-input-* rows, B2B badges (84 occurrences read-only), all 3 root testids (dealer-prices-editor, prices-bulk-markup, prices-save) render. Bulk markup panel opens with bulk-markup-panel + bulk-markup-apply, percent/base/scope/overwrite controls visible. Zamówienia tab shows the 3 new columns 'Klient płaci' (20000 PLN), 'Koszt WM' (15000 PLN), 'Marża' (5000 PLN / 33.3% in green) for the confirmed test order — exactly matching the spec example. Empty manufacturerTotal would render dash per source. Calculator screen also renders correctly with base WM prices for models without dealer retail. ConfirmOrderDialog 2-card breakdown is wired in source (DealerCalculatorWrapper.jsx) and would surface when manufacturerTotal is set — not visually re-triggered in this run because the seed dialog flow requires going through Calculator → Save which would duplicate the already-confirmed test order.
critical_code_review_comments: dealer.py:_apply_overrides — costPrice strip is recursive but only triggers at the top after override apply; if any nested catalog ever ships costPrice on a list element of dict-of-dicts depth >3 it's still covered (recursion is full-depth). OK.

dealer.py:dealer_put_overrides — DELETE+INSERT_MANY is not transactional; on a partial Mongo failure the dealer loses ALL overrides. Consider a session/bulk_write replacement strategy or per-key update_many($set) for atomicity.

dealer.py:_compute_manufacturer_totals — option_variant fallback `base = ov_option.get(oid, wm_option.get(oid, 0))` adds wm_opt_variant on top when no opt_variant override exists. Correct for additive variant pricing but documenting this in a docstring would help next maintainer.
dealer.py:admin_recompute_manufacturer_totals — iterates with async for + per-doc update_one; for large dealer-order counts a bulk_write([UpdateOne(...)]) is ~10x faster.

routes/sauna_orders.py:_recompute_one — when source=='dealer' and manufacturerTotal is missing, falls back to order.get('total') which IS the dealer-retail (=customer-paying), producing INFLATED margins. Recommend: skip margin recompute for dealer orders without manufacturerTotal and surface a `needsBackfill: true` flag instead — main agent can decide.

DealerApp.jsx PricesTab — 82 separate retail-input-* inputs means 82 controlled-state hooks; on very large catalogs this may cause input-lag. Consider virtualization (react-window) when row count > 200.
